inline.headline: Grease doesn't send reminders.
inline.text: Add the rangehood filter to Jib once, set it to repeat every couple of months, and it reminds you before the build-up gets there.
inline.alt: A mum unclipping a metal filter from under a rangehood in her kitchen

jobs.title: Clean the rangehood filter
jobs.description: Metal mesh filter. Soak, scrub and dry before refitting.
directions: Turn the rangehood off, let the cooktop cool
Soak in hot soapy water for 10 minutes
Scrub gently, rinse and dry fully

end.headline: Cook more. Scrub less.
end.alt: A family cooking a stir fry together in a clean kitchen, the rangehood running above them

jobs.title: Replace the charcoal rangehood filter
jobs.description: Recirculating rangehood. Check the part number first.
directions: Note the rangehood model and part number
Twist out the old filter, fit the new one
